integrity: The infinite statement is proved directly. Finite exhaustive checks are corroborative only and are not used to infer the universal theorem. The closest motivating source was inspected at the statement, proof, and downstream-use locations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem sharpens a local perturbation lemma and its direct finite-set bounds; it does not by itself change the exponent range of the motivating asymptotic-basis theorem, and it does not address composite moduli or multiple forbidden residues per coordinate.
title: Parity-sharp bounded congruence avoidance under zero-sum shifts
